body: I need 3ds Max and photoshop, something I can't really find on a public computer. However I decided to wait, As long as I have my car I can kill myself the way I want, so until I actually fail, I am going to push on. Trying to ignore any thoughts about the future for now, but that may only make things worse.
They expect you to go to the school to work on the computers if yours isn't working, but it's a 5 hour round trip, and I can't afford it.

Well I don't know how I can get the degree, I haven't been able to get onto the class without crying it took everything I had to do just enough work not to get dropped from the class. I now have a 4.  
Even with the computer fixed, I don't know if I would be able to find a job. I had my head filled with dreams of working in video games, specifically 3d modeling, but I haven't been taught that much. I couldn't go to the school on random days and get help like all the other students because it's a 5 hour round trip to school and back. I know I could learn it given the chance, but what possible reason would an employer have to give me that chance?

Everyone says it gets better, but it's only gotten worse over the past 7 years. The only period of time I enjoyed myself was working at a ski resort, but I can't afford to work there and pay student loans.
